other_conditions: One of the parents must be an active, registered member of the Jammu and Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board at the time of application
The registration must be renewed annually
The child must be studying in Nursery to Class 8th
The applicant should have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
benefits_summary: ₹2,500 per child in Nursery to Class 5 and ₹3,500 per child in Class 6 to 8 as education assistance
